title: Can CCS stop the AI boom from blowing the carbon budget?
summary: SINTEF news item noting that data centres could account for 7 per cent of global electricity demand. At the UN climate summit COP31, SINTEF's Mona Mølnvik argued that gas power with carbon capture is a possible solution, provided that solutions that cannot be fixed afterwards are not locked in. (Summary from the SINTEF feed; the page could not be opened.)
why_it_matters: Gas power with CCS to supply data centres would add a new class of CO₂ sources that Nordic transport and storage networks would have to collect, which changes demand scenarios for hub and storage capacity planning.
